in_sanskrit.name: Sullan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Sun
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sullan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Sullan is a Hindi name that is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Suryalana' which means 'Lord of the Sun'. This name is believed to bestow the strength and power of the Sun upon the bearer.
